subject_session: ses-03020601 (12 units, 600 s open-field; dandiset 000582 Sargolini/Moser MEC)

headline_stat.name: grid cells (gridness > shuffle 95th pct) in ses-03020601

justification.dataset: Selected dandiset 000582 (Sargolini/Moser MEC open-field), the canonical grid-cell dataset in the correct species, region, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile and correctly loaded/aligned for session 1, but no unit quality filtering and the multi-session script crashed on ses-01020602 (duration=0) before finishing.
justification.analysis: Standard, correctly implemented grid analysis: Pearson spatial autocorrelogram, gridness score over an auto-detected annulus, and a circular-shift shuffle null for per-unit classification.
justification.correctness: Session-1 gridness and shuffle-threshold values reproduce from the committed log, are internally consistent with the autocorrelogram figure, and are physically plausible, but results were never persisted or reported in full.
justification.figures: Only prototype/test figures exist; test_autocorr.png clearly shows hexagonal grid structure for the top units but lacks axis units, sample sizes, and any population summary, and the intended final figures were never generated.
justification.honesty: There is no write-up at all, so nothing is misrepresented and no fabrication occurred, but no conclusion, calibration, or limitations were ever stated, leaving the result unassessable as a claim.
justification.verdict: The dataset and method are sound and session 1 shows real grid cells, but the run crashed before completing, produced no final figures, and wrote no summary or conclusion, so it must be reworked before it could be believed.
